apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
  name: sprintctl-remote-backfill-egress
  namespace: vuoro-shared
spec:
  # Scoped narrowly to the one-off sprintctl-remote-backfill job pods only
  # (not vuoro-shared namespace-wide) so they can reach the legacy
  # sprintctl-cnpg-main database in vscode to copy each still-direct-remote
  # workstation repo's history in. Paired with the matching ingress rule in
  # sprintctl-postgres/app/networkpolicy.yaml. Remove once the 7 workstation
  # repos have all been backfilled.
  podSelector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: sprintctl-remote-backfill
  policyTypes: [Egress]
  egress:
    - to:
        - namespaceSelector:
            matchLabels:
              kubernetes.io/metadata.name: vscode
          podSelector:
            matchExpressions:
              - key: cnpg.io/cluster
                operator: In
                values:
                  - sprintctl-cnpg-main
      ports:
        - protocol: TCP
          port: 5432
